## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Checks

- [ ] No personal paths, credentials, certificates, game files, or generated binaries were added.
- [ ] Third-party notices remain intact.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration were updated where needed.
- [ ] `npm ci` and `npm run docs:build` pass.
- [ ] Native build/tests were run, or the reason they could not be run is explained.
